chunks: Yunus, from some of his companions, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام.

A woman vowed that she would be led by a nose-rope. Then a camel pushed her and tore her nose, so she came to Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام disputing with the owner of the camel. He nullified it and said: “You only made a vow; that is not binding upon you.”

key_terms.مَزْمُومَةً: with a nose-rope or halter attached to the nose

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling when someone is injured while carrying out a personal vow?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal judgment by Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام regarding harm connected to a vowed act. It indicates that a self-imposed vow of this kind did not establish liability in the manner the woman claimed, so her case against the camel's owner was dismissed.
